title: Term review
intro: Check the labels and explanations of the medical terms. A change reaches every clinic.
readOnly: Only reviewers can edit and approve terms.
progressNeedsChanges: {count, plural, one {# needs changes} other {# need changes}}
shortcut.move: ↓ and ↑, or J and K: next or previous term
shortcut.labels: A, E, N: approve, edit or request changes to the labels
shortcut.explanation: Shift with A, E, N: the same for the explanation
loadFailed: The review queue is not available. Try again.
conflict: Someone changed this entry in the meantime. The queue has been reloaded.
invalid: Check the text: a label has at most 300 characters and no |, an explanation at most 500 characters.
explanationHint: Plain language, at most 500 characters. Informational only, never a diagnosis.
